captured.description: false when git could not be read; then reason is set and head_commit, worktree_dirty and patch are null.

base_commit.description: The commit the workspace's base_revision resolved to when git evidence exists; the requested name otherwise.

base_revision_requested.description: The base_revision the request named, as asked. Optional.

head_commit.description: git rev-parse HEAD; the harness may have committed.

worktree_dirty.description: The staged diff against HEAD is non-empty.

truncated.description: The diff exceeded 8 MiB and was cut.

brief.description: The item brief the request carried (brief-v1), also staged as brief.json; null when the item had none.

branch.description: Filled by the branch-push task; null until then.
